# Rippling

> Rippling is the #1 unified workforce management platform combining HR, Payroll, IT, and Finance into a single integrated system with AI automation and analytics.

Rippling provides end-to-end workforce management solutions for companies of all sizes, with specialized industry solutions for construction, financial services, healthcare, and fitness. The platform emphasizes automation, compliance, and unified employee data through its proprietary Employee Graph technology.

## Key Topics

- Workforce Management
- HR Management
- Payroll Automation
- IT Management
- HCM Platform
- Workflow Automation
- Employee Lifecycle
- Compliance Management
- Workforce Analytics
- Global Payroll
- AI Automation
- App Studio
- Role-Based Access Control
- No-Code Integration
- Spend Management

- [Explore Rippling's Product Ecosystem](https://www.rippling.com/products): Product ecosystem overview: HR, Payroll, IT, Finance integrated solutions

## Products & Solutions

- [HCM Software That Makes HR More Strategic](https://www.rippling.com/products/hr): HCM platform automating HR lifecycle, compliance, and workforce analytics
- [Your Business Is Complex. Payroll Software Shouldn't Be.](https://www.rippling.com/products/payroll): Global payroll automation with compliance, configurability, and AI features
- [End-to-end IT Management Software](https://www.rippling.com/products/it): IT management: identity, device, inventory control across user lifecycle
- [Spend Management Software - Cloud Solution for Businesses](https://www.rippling.com/products/finance): Spend management: expenses, corporate cards, bill pay, payroll automation
- [#1 Global Payroll Services and Software for Global Teams](https://www.rippling.com/products/global): Global payroll, EOR, COR services for international workforce management

## Platform Capabilities

- [Rippling AI: HR, Payroll and IT Automation](https://www.rippling.com/platform/ai): AI automation for HR, Payroll, IT teams with real-time insights
- [HR Workflow Automation: Streamline Your HR Processes](https://www.rippling.com/platform/workflows): No-code workflow automation for HR, IT, finance across multiple systems
- [Workforce Analytics That Accelerate Business Impact](https://www.rippling.com/platform/analytics): Unified workforce analytics from HR, IT, Finance, third-party systems
- [Enforce Your Company Policies Automatically](https://www.rippling.com/platform/policies): Automated policy enforcement: PTO, app access, compliance management
- [Automate Role-Based Permissions and Approvals](https://www.rippling.com/platform/permissions): Role-based access control and automated approval workflows

## Integrations & Extensibility

- [Push Your Apps to Perform At Their Best](https://www.rippling.com/platform/integrations): Integrations with GitHub, Carta, Jira, Datadog, and app ecosystem
- [Build Powerful Apps to Automate Any Process](https://www.rippling.com/platform/app-studio): No-code app builder for custom automation using Employee Graph data
- [Custom apps built on demand by Rippling engineers](https://www.rippling.com/rippling-solutions): Custom app development service for enterprise automation and integration
